result.summary: The image shows a residential corner with paved sidewalks but a complete lack of crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. Significant overgrown vegetation on the corner property creates a major visual obstruction for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation and hedges on the corner property block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and center, covering the corner property

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the corner makes the transition from sidewalk to street difficult or impossible for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown hedges and vines at the corner to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant directional curb ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers to crossing locations.

result.summary: A residential street featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and a stop sign at a T-intersection. The roadway is notably wide and lacks lane markings, with a sidewalk clearly visible only on the left side of the street.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground roadway

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and dense vegetation on the right side of the road may obscure pedestrians from drivers' view.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to narrow the travel lanes and encourage slower speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous, safe path for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow two-lane road bordered by a concrete sidewalk and dense wooded vegetation. A significant pile of debris and illegal dumping is present in the roadway gutter, and the asphalt surface is in poor condition with visible cracking and lack of markings.

hazards.name: Illegal dumping and debris
hazards.description: A large pile of trash, construction waste, and bags is obstructing the gutter and edge of the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the edge of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and shows signs of significant degradation.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible roadway

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may create safety issues for pedestrians at night given the dense foliage.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

interventions.title: Debris Removal and Sanitation
interventions.description: Clear the illegal dumping to restore the full width of the roadway and improve the environment.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security along the wooded corridor.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the asphalt to eliminate trip hazards and improve drainage.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a residential street with a sidewalk present on only one side and no marked crossings. The wide, unmarked asphalt and dense vegetation at the curve create significant sightline issues and lack clear guidance for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross an unmarked, wide roadway at a curve without designated space or right-of-way indicators.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the asphalt roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and overgrown vegetation on the left side of the curve limit sightlines for approaching vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curve

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk network
hazards.description: The sidewalk is only present on the right side, forcing pedestrians to walk on unpaved shoulders or in the roadway on the opposite side.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway where the red truck is parked

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with continental markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous, separated path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corner to improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back dense vegetation to improve sightlines for drivers and pedestrians navigating the curve.
